A PlotTrellis project is one text file, `samples.txt`: your genome, then one row per sample
and one column per kind of data. The app's wizard writes it for you, and so can an
[AI assistant](samples-txt-ai-prompt.html). For what each file must contain, see [Input data](inputs.html).

# The file

```
# data_root: /data/smithlab/tcell_2026
# gtf_path: /data/reference/gencode.v44.annotation.gtf.gz
# orgdb: org.Hs.eg.db
# genome_label: hg38
condition	colour	bw:ATAC	paired-end:junctions	quantdir:salmon
Control	#1b9e77	atac/Control.bw	junctions/Control_SJ.bed	salmon/Control
KO	#d95f02	atac/KO.bw		salmon/KO
```

Columns are separated by tabs. KO has no
junctions file, so its cell is empty.

# Settings lines

| Line | Holds |
|---|---|
| `# data_root:` | The folder your data is in. The table's paths are relative to it. |
| `# gtf_path:` | The gene annotation, `.gtf` or `.gtf.gz` (see [Input data](inputs.html#genome)). |
| `# orgdb:` | `org.Mm.eg.db` (mouse) or `org.Hs.eg.db` (human). |
| `# genome_label:` | The genome build's UCSC name: `mm39`, `mm10`, `hg38` or `hg19`. |

`data_root` and `gtf_path` can be full paths or relative to the folder `samples.txt` is in.
Any other `# key: value` line sets an app setting (e.g. `# fontsize: 12`). Other lines
starting with `#` are comments.

# The table

| Column | Required | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| `condition` | yes | The sample's name, each one different. |
| `colour` | no | The sample's colour, e.g. `#1b9e77`. |
| `type:name` | at least one | A path relative to `data_root`. Empty if the sample has no such file. |

`type` says what kind of file it is; `name` names the track (e.g. `bw:ATAC` intakes `bw` files and makes tracks called
`ATAC`).

| Type | Files | Track |
|---|---|---|
| `bw` | bigWig (`.bw`, `.bigWig`) | coverage (ATAC-seq, ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, RNA-seq) |
| `quantdir` | a Salmon output folder, the one holding `quant.sf` | transcript expression |
| `paired-end` | BED12 or BED6 junctions, STAR `SJ.out.tab`, BEDPE, HiCCUPS loops | arcs (splice junctions, loops) |
| `hic` | `.hic`, `.cool`, `.mcool` | Hi-C contact map |
| `bed` | BED, narrowPeak, broadPeak, gappedPeak | intervals (peaks, regions) |

`bed` and `paired-end` files can be gzipped. An arc's height is its read count: the score
column (BED column 5, BEDPE column 8) or an `SJ.out.tab`'s unique reads.

**One column per data type, not per sample.** Tracks with the same name share one scale, and
comparison tracks (one sample against another) need a name both samples have. Names are
case-sensitive.

Other files need converting first:

| You have | Convert with |
|---|---|
| BAM | deepTools `bamCoverage`, to bigWig |
| bedGraph, wig | UCSC `bedGraphToBigWig`, `wigToBigWig` |
| Hi-C `.pairs` | Juicer Tools `pre` (to `.hic`) or cooler (to `.mcool`) |
| kallisto, RSEM, counts | not supported: PlotTrellis reads Salmon's `quant.sf` |


# Checks

PlotTrellis checks the file when it opens it. An unknown type, a missing or repeated
`condition`, or a bad column name stops it with a message. A path that does not resolve is a
warning: everything else loads, and that track is marked as missing. After editing `samples.txt`, run the same
`run_plottrellis()` command again to update the project.
